
```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
library(marginaleffects)
```


```{r}
sbc <- readRDS(here("data", 'sbc_post_turnv2.rds'))
back_given_place_summ <- read_csv(here("data", 'conditional_back_summary.csv'))
```


```{r}
sbc <- sbc %>% left_join(back_given_place_summ, by = c(text = "word", "place"))
```

```{r}
sbc_noninit <- sbc %>%
  mutate(has_overlap_onset = str_detect(transcript, "\\[")) %>%
  filter(place != 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_back))
```

```{r}
ggplot(sbc_noninit, aes(y = as.numeric(has_overlap_onset), x = mean_back)) +
  stat_
```


```{r}
model_overlap_on_place_meanback <- glmer(
  has_overlap_onset ~ place + mean_back + (1 | docId),
  data = sbc_noninit,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
model_overlap_on_place <- glmer(
  has_overlap_onset ~ place + (1 | docId),
  data = sbc_noninit,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
model_overlap_on_meanback <- glmer(
  has_overlap_onset ~ mean_back + (1 | docId),
  data = sbc_noninit,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
```

```{r}
model_overlap_on_medianback <- glmer(
```


# Divide into BC or not


```{r}
# Opening-bracket label of each word, e.g. "[" or "[2" (NA if none)
sbc <- sbc %>%
  mutate(overlap_label = str_extract(transcript, "\\[\\d*"))

# Next two units (within the same doc), their turnTypes, and whether the next has any overlap
unit_info <- sbc %>%
  group_by(docId, unitId) %>%
  summarise(
    unit_turnType = first(turnType),
    unit_has_overlap = any(isOverlap %in% TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(docId, unitId) %>%
  group_by(docId) %>%
  mutate(
    next_unitId = lead(unitId),
    next_turnType = lead(unit_turnType),
    next_has_overlap = lead(unit_has_overlap),
    next2_unitId = lead(unitId, 2),
    next2_turnType = lead(unit_turnType, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(docId, unitId, next_unitId, next_turnType, next_has_overlap,
         next2_unitId, next2_turnType)

# Opening brackets in each unit, keyed so they can be matched from an earlier unit
open_brackets <- sbc %>%
  filter(!is.na(overlap_label)) %>%
  distinct(docId, unitId, overlap_label)

sbc <- sbc %>%
  left_join(unit_info, by = c("docId", "unitId")) %>%
  left_join(
    open_brackets %>% mutate(next_has_match = TRUE),
    by = c("docId", next_unitId = "unitId", "overlap_label")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    open_brackets %>% mutate(next2_has_match = TRUE),
    by = c("docId", next2_unitId = "unitId", "overlap_label")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    next_has_match = coalesce(next_has_match, FALSE),
    # Only look two units ahead if the next unit has some (other) overlapped portion
    next2_has_match = !next_has_match &
      coalesce(next_has_overlap, FALSE) &
      coalesce(next2_has_match, FALSE),
    has_overlap_onset = next_has_match | next2_has_match,
    match_turnType = if_else(next_has_match, next_turnType, next2_turnType),
    has_bc_onset = has_overlap_onset &
      coalesce(str_detect(match_turnType, "^\\s*back"), FALSE),
    has_turn_onset = has_overlap_onset & !has_bc_onset
  ) %>%
  select(-c(next_unitId, next_turnType, next_has_overlap, next2_unitId,
            next2_turnType, next_has_match, next2_has_match, match_turnType))

# Whether any word in the turn has a BC / turn onset (NA where turnSeq is missing)
sbc <- sbc %>%
  group_by(docId, turnSeq) %>%
  mutate(
    turn_has_bc_onset = if_else(is.na(turnSeq), NA, any(has_bc_onset)),
    turn_has_turn_onset = if_else(is.na(turnSeq), NA, any(has_turn_onset))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
sbc_noninit <- sbc %>%
  filter(place != 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_back))
```


```{r}
model_overlap_on_modeback <- glmer(
  has_overlap_onset ~ has_bc_onset * (mode_back + place) + (1 | docId),
  data = sbc_noninit,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
model_overlap_on_modeback <- glmer(
  has_overlap_onset ~ has_bc_onset * (mode_back + place) + (1 | docId),
  data = sbc_noninit,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
```


```{r}
plot_predictions(
  model_overlap_on_modeback,
  condition = list("mode_back", has_bc_onset = TRUE)
)
plot_predictions(
  model_overlap_on_modeback,
  condition = list("mode_back", has_bc_onset = FALSE)
)
```
